tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters might think that {@creature Gadof Blinsky|CoS}, the toymaker of Vallaki ({@area area N7|3df|x}), is the figure they seek, because he has a pet monkey. If they speak to him about this possibility, Blinsky jokes that he and the monkey are "old friends," but if the characters ask him to come with them to fight Strahd, he politely declines. If the characters tell him about the tarokka reading, Blinsky admits that he acquired the monkey from a half-elf carnival ringmaster named {@creature Rictavio|CoS}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 玩家們可能會誤認為這張牌所指的人是瓦拉吉鎮（{@area 區域N7|3df|x}）的玩具工匠{@creature 加多夫·布林斯基|CoS}，因為他有一隻寵物猴子。如果角色們去探問他，布林斯基會開玩笑說他和猴子是"老朋友"。但是如果角色們邀請他加入隊伍對抗施特拉德，他會婉言拒絕。如果玩家們對他說出塔羅卡牌占卜的事，布林斯基會說他是從一位半精靈馬戲班班主{@creature 瑞克塔維歐|CoS}那兒得到這隻猴子的。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters don't have the means to raise Nikolai from the dead, {@creature Rictavio|CoS} (see {@area appendix D|7b8|x}) gives them a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell raise dead} if he learns of their need. If they're staying at the Blue Water Inn, he leaves the scroll in one of their rooms.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們沒有復活尼古拉的技能或者方法並且{@creature 瑞克塔維歐|CoS}（見{@area 附錄D|7b8|x}）知道了這件事的話，他會想辦法給玩家一個{@spell 死者復活}{@item 法術卷軸}。如果玩家住藍水旅館，他會把卷軸留在其中一人的房間裡。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters agree to accompany the Vistani, the Vistani lead them south along the Trade Way. After several days of uneventful travel, the mists of Ravenloft engulf the caravan, transporting the characters and the Vistani to Barovia. The Vistani then lead the party safely to their leader, {@creature Madam Eva|CoS}, at {@area area G|10e|x} (see {@adventure chapter 2|CoS|3}). The characters arrive at {@area area A|0f9|x} and are taken through {@area areas B|0fb|x}, {@area E|108|x}, and {@area F|109|x} on the way to {@creature Madam Eva|CoS}'s camp. If the characters rid themselves of their Vistani hosts before reaching {@creature Madam Eva|CoS}'s camp, they're on their own.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們同意陪同維斯塔尼人，維斯塔尼人會帶領他們沿著貿易之路向南行進。經過數日平靜的旅程後，鴉閣魔域的迷霧籠罩了車隊，將角色們和維斯塔尼人傳送到了巴洛維亞。隨後，維斯塔尼人會帶領隊伍安全地前往他們的首領——位於{@area 區域G|10e|x}的{@creature 伊娃夫人|CoS}處（見{@adventure 第二章|CoS|3}）。角色們抵達{@area 區域A|0f9|x}，並在前往{@creature 伊娃夫人|CoS}營地的途中，會經過{@area 區域B|0fb|x}、{@area E|108|x}和{@area F|109|x}。如果角色們在到達{@creature 伊娃夫人|CoS}的營地之前就擺脫了他們的維斯塔尼主人，那麼他們就只能靠自己了。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The area within the fog is {@quickref Vision and Light||2||heavily obscured} (see "{@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||Vision and Light}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 迷霧內的區域處於{@quickref 視野與光照||2||重度遮蔽}狀態（參見{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}第八章中的"{@quickref 視野與光照|PHB|2||視野與光照}"）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When a humanoid who has been dead for at least 24 hours returns to life, either by way of a spell or some supernatural means, it gains a random form of indefinite madness brought on by the realization that its spirit is trapped in Barovia, likely forever. To determine how this madness is expressed, roll on the {@table Indefinite Madness} table in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當一個類人生物死亡至少24小時後，透過法術或某種超自然手段復活時，它會獲得一種隨機的永久性瘋狂形態，這是因為它意識到自己的精魄被困在巴洛維亞，很可能永遠無法離開。要確定這種瘋狂的表現形式，請在{@book 城主指南|DMG}第八章的{@table 永久性瘋狂}表格上進行擲骰。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A random character finds a lost trinket. Roll on the {@item Trinket|CoS|Trinkets table} in {@adventure appendix A|CoS|18}, select a specific trinket from the table, or create one on the fly.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個隨機角色發現了一個丟失的飾品。在{@adventure 附錄A|CoS|18}的{@item 飾品|CoS|飾品表}上擲骰，從表格中選擇一個特定的飾品，或者當場編造一個。

tagShapeMismatches.english: One magic item (roll once on {@table Magic Item Table B} in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG})
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一件魔法物品（在{@book 城主指南|DMG}的{@table 魔法物品表B}上擲骰一次）

tagShapeMismatches.english: The Mad Mage has a different spell list from that of the {@creature archmage} in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, and he has already used one 1st-level spell slot to cast {@spell mage armor} on himself, one 4th-level spell slot to cast {@spell polymorph} on himself, one 7th-level spell slot to cast {@spell Mordenkainen's magnificent mansion} (see "{@area The Mad Mage's Mansion|129|x}"), and one 8th-level spell slot to cast {@spell mind blank} on himself.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這位瘋法師的法術列表與{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 大法師}不同，並且他已經消耗了一個1環法術位向自己施放了{@spell 法師護甲}，一個4環法術位向自己施放了{@spell 變形術}，一個7環法術位施放了{@spell 魔鄧肯豪宅術}（見"{@area 瘋法師的宅邸|129|x}"），以及一個8環法術位向自己施放了{@spell 心靈屏障}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Mary hid her beloved daughter, {@creature Gertruda|CoS}, in this house for the girl's entire life. {@creature Gertruda|CoS}, now a teenager, broke out of the house a week ago and has not been seen since. Her mother fears the worst—and is justified in doing so. See {@area area K42|218|x} in chapter 4 for more information on {@creature Gertruda|CoS}'s fate.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 瑪麗將她深愛的女兒{@creature 歌爾圖達|CoS}藏在這所房子裡度過了女孩的整個童年。現已長成青少年的{@creature 歌爾圖達|CoS}一週前從這所房子逃出去，至今下落不明。她的母親擔心最壞的情況發生了——而且她的擔心是有道理的。關於{@creature 歌爾圖達|CoS}的命運，詳見第4章的{@area 區域K42|218|x}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: To determine what the character finds, roll on the {@item Trinket|CoS|Trinkets table} in {@adventure appendix A|CoS|18}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 要決定該角色找到了什麼，在{@adventure 附錄A|CoS|18}的{@item 飾品|CoS|飾品表}上進行擲骰。

tagShapeMismatches.english: This unseen servant was created by Strahd and is permanent until destroyed (see the {@spell unseen servant} spell in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}). Roll a {@dice d6} to determine what the servant is carrying, or choose one of the options below.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這個隱形僕役由施特拉德創造並永久存在，直到被摧毀（見{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}中的{@spell 隱形僕役}法術）。擲一個{@dice d6}來決定僕役攜帶的物品，或從下方選項中選擇一個。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Mounted on the walls along the section of staircase nearest the heart are ten {@creature Animated Halberd|CoS|animated halberds}; use the stat block for the {@creature flying sword} in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, but increase each halberd's damage to {@dice 1d10 + 1} and reduce its AC to 15. The halberds attack any creature that threatens the Heart of Sorrow.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 安裝在最靠近心臟的樓梯段牆壁上的是十把{@creature 活化長戟|CoS|活化長戟}；使用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中{@creature 凌空劍}的資料卡，但將每把長戟的傷害增加到{@dice 1d10 + 1}並將其AC降低到15。這些長戟會攻擊任何威脅悲痛之心的生物。

tagShapeMismatches.english: There is no danger in this area during the day. But if the characters try to take a short rest here during the night, the rest is interrupted by the arrival of {@dice 1d4} {@creature Barovian Witch|CoS|Barovian witches} from {@area area K56|239|x}. They try to subdue the party with {@spell sleep} spells. A witch retreats to {@area area K56|239|x} if wounded.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這裡在白晝期間沒有危險。但如果角色們試圖在黑夜期間在此短休，休息將被來自{@area 區域K56|239|x}的{@dice 1d4}個{@creature 巴洛維亞巫師|CoS|巴洛維亞巫師}的抵達所打斷。他們會嘗試用{@spell 睡眠術}法術制服隊伍。負傷的巫師會撤退回到{@area 區域K56|239|x}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Hiding in the rafters is {@creature Pidlwick II|CoS} (see {@area appendix D|7a5|x}). A character spots {@creature Pidlwick II|CoS} with a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score that meets or exceeds its Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. If {@creature Pidlwick II|CoS} is spotted, read:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 藏在屋頂樑架裡的是{@creature 搗蛋皮德爾二世|CoS}（見{@area 附錄D|7a5|x}）。角色的感知（{@skill 察覺}）被動屬性值等於或超過其敏捷（{@skill 隱匿}）檢定時即可發現{@creature 搗蛋皮德爾二世|CoS}。如果{@creature 搗蛋皮德爾二世|CoS}被發現，讀出：

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters see {@creature Pidlwick II|CoS} in {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}, read:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色在{@quickref 視野與光照||2||明亮光照}中看到{@creature 搗蛋皮德爾二世|CoS}，則閱讀：

tagShapeMismatches.english: The iron chest is locked, and its key is with {@creature Cyrus Belview|CoS} in {@area area K62|252|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 鐵箱子已經上鎖，其鑰匙在{@area 區域K62|252|x}的{@creature 賽勒斯·貝爾維|CoS}身上。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The light in the hall comes from a lantern on the floor behind Cyrus. If the characters have their own light sources, Cyrus sees them, but he will not attack first. He wears a loop of twine around his neck, hanging from which is an iron key and a decorative wooden pendant fitted with a varnished human eyeball. The key unlocks the iron chest in {@area area K60|247|x}. The wooden pendant is a {@i hag eye} given to Cyrus by the {@creature night hag} {@creature Morgantha|CoS} (see {@adventure chapter 6|CoS|7}), so that she could spy on Strahd. Cyrus doesn't know that the necklace is magical. See the "Hag Covens" sidebar in the hags entry in the {@book Monster Manual|MM} for information about the {@i hag eye}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 大廳的光照來自賽勒斯身後地板上的一盞提燈。如果角色們自帶光源，賽勒斯就會看見他們，但他不會先發動攻擊。他脖子上戴著一圈細繩，上面掛著一把鐵鑰匙和一個裝飾性的木製墜飾，內嵌著一隻裹清漆的人類眼球。這把鑰匙可以開啟{@area 區域K60|247|x}的鐵箱。這個木製墜飾是一個{@i 鬼婆之眼}，由{@creature 夜鬼婆}{@creature 摩甘薩|CoS}（見{@adventure 第六章|CoS|7}）送給賽勒斯，以便她監視施特拉德。賽勒斯不知道這條項鍊帶有魔法。關於{@i 鬼婆之眼}的更多資訊，請參閱{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中鬼婆條目的"鬼婆集會"側邊欄。

tagShapeMismatches.english: These teleport traps form a protective ring around the entrance to Strahd's tomb ({@area area K86|31b|x}). Any creature that enters one of these 10-foot-square spaces is instantly teleported away, switching places with one of the {@creature Wight||wights} in {@area crypt 14|2d0|x}. The wight materializes in the creature's previous location and attacks any living creature it sees.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這些傳送陷阱在施特拉德墓穴（{@area 區域K86|31b|x}）的入口周圍形成一個保護環。任何進入其中一個10尺方形區域的生物會立即被傳送走，並與{@area 墓穴14|2d0|x}中的一個{@creature 屍妖||屍妖}交換位置。該屍妖會出現在生物先前的位置，並攻擊它看到的任何活體生物。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals that the thighbone radiates an aura of evocation magic. See {@adventure appendix C|CoS|20} for more information on {@item Saint Markovia's thighbone|CoS}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個 {@spell 偵測魔法} 法術顯示該股骨散發著塑能魔法的靈光。關於 {@item 聖馬柯維婭的股骨|CoS} 的更多資訊，請參閱 {@adventure 附錄C|CoS|20}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Patrina's crypt contains 250 pp, 1,100 gp, 2,300 ep, 5,200 sp, and 8,000 cp. The coins are of a mixed origin. The platinum and electrum coins have Strahd's profiled visage stamped on them. Buried under the coins is Patrina's spellbook, which has carved wooden covers. It contains all the spells listed for the {@creature archmage} in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 帕特里娜的墓穴裡有250 pp、1,100 gp、2,300 ep、5,200 sp和8,000 cp。這些錢幣來源混雜。鉑金幣和銀金幣上鑄有施特拉德的側面肖像。錢幣下面埋著帕特里娜的法術書，其封面為木刻。書中包含了{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中{@creature 大法師}所列的所有法術。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If she is restored to life by her brother (see "{@area Kasimir's Dark Gift|670|x}" in the "Special Events" section in {@adventure chapter 13|CoS|14}), Patrina (NE female dusk elf) returns as an {@creature archmage} with no spells prepared. If the characters have her spellbook, she kindly asks them to give it back to her so that she can prepare her long-forgotten spells and help destroy Strahd (a lie). If the characters oblige, she repays their kindness by learning as much about them as possible before pursuing her own goals.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果她被其兄弟復活（見{@adventure 第十三章|CoS|14}中"特殊事件"部分的"{@area 卡西米爾的黑暗贈禮|670|x}"），帕特里娜（中立邪惡的女性黃昏精靈）會作為一個未準備任何法術的{@creature 大法師}復活。如果角色們帶著她的法術書，她會彬彬有禮地請大家把書還給她，以便她能準備自己早已遺忘的法術並協助摧毀施特拉德（這是個謊言）。如果角色們照做，她會透過儘可能多地瞭解他們來回報這份善意，然後再追求自己的目的。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A human skeleton (the remains of a dead adventurer) wrapped in bits of studded leather armor lies amid the spikes at the bottom of the pit. A shattered lantern and a rusty {@item crowbar|PHB} lie nearby. Tied to the corpse's leather belt is a {@item Hempen Rope (50 feet)|PHB|50-foot coil of hempen rope}, a {@item dagger|PHB} in a worn scabbard, a pouch containing 25 pp, and a stoppered wooden tube containing a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell magic circle}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一具人類骷髏（一名死去的冒險者的遺骸）裹著鑲釘皮甲的碎片躺在坑底的尖刺中。一個破碎的提燈和一把生鏽的{@item 撬棍|PHB}放在旁邊。系在屍體皮帶上的是{@item 麻繩(50尺)|PHB|50尺麻繩卷}、一把插在磨損刀鞘中的{@item 匕首|PHB}、一個裝有25鉑金幣的小包和一個塞好的木製卷軸管，裡面裝著一張{@spell 防護法陣}的{@item 法術卷軸}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: In addition to the information known to all Barovians (see "{@area Barovian Lore|0ad|x}" in {@adventure chapter 2|CoS|3}), Vallakians know the following bits of local lore:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 除了所有巴洛維亞人已知的資訊（參見{@adventure 第二章|CoS|3}中的"{@area 巴洛維亞傳聞|0ad|x}"），瓦拉吉鎮居民還知道以下當地傳聞：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Victor's spellbook contains all the spells Victor has prepared (see the {@creature mage} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}) as well as the following spells: {@spell animate dead}, {@spell blight}, {@spell cloudkill}, {@spell darkvision}, {@spell glyph of warding}, {@spell levitate}, {@spell remove curse}, and {@spell thunderwave}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 維克託的法術書包含維克託準備好的所有法術（參見{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 魔法師}資料卡）以及以下法術：{@spell 活化死屍}、{@spell 枯萎術}、{@spell 死雲術}、{@spell 黑暗視覺}、{@spell 守衛刻文}、{@spell 浮空術}、{@spell 移除詛咒}和{@spell 雷鳴波}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Lady Wachter has a different list of prepared spells from that of the {@creature priest} in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 瓦赫特女士的準備法術列表與{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 祭司}不同：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Blinsky is a heavyset man who wears a moth-eaten jester's cap during store hours, more out of habit than to humor visitors. In the past six months, the only paying customer who has set foot in the store is a visitor from a faraway land named {@creature Rictavio|CoS} (see {@area area N2|333|x}), who came in two weeks ago and bought a stuffed Vistana doll. Realizing that the toymaker was lonely, {@creature Rictavio|CoS} gave Blinsky his pet monkey, {@creature Piccolo|CoS} (use the {@creature baboon} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}). Overjoyed, Blinsky has begun training the monkey to fetch toys from hard-to-reach shelves. The toymaker has also fitted {@creature Piccolo|CoS} with a custom-tailored ballerina tutu.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 布林斯基是一個身材魁梧的男人，在營業時間會戴著一頂被蟲蛀過的小丑帽，這更多是出於習慣而非為了取悅顧客。過去六個月裡，唯一一個踏入店內的顧客是來自遙遠地方的訪客{@creature 瑞克塔維歐|CoS}（見{@area 區域N2|333|x}），他兩個星期前來到這裡併購買了一個填充式的維斯塔尼娃娃。看著玩具商這麼孤單，{@creature 瑞克塔維歐|CoS}將他的寵物猴{@creature 小笛子|CoS}（使用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 狒狒}資料卡）送給了布林斯基。喜不自勝的布林斯基開始訓練猴子從高層的架子上取玩具。玩具商還為{@creature 小笛子|CoS}量身定製了一件芭蕾舞短裙。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters rescue {@creature Arabelle|CoS} from Lake Zarovich ({@adventure chapter 2|CoS|3}, {@area area L|121|x}) and see her safely returned to camp, {@creature Luvash|CoS} is overjoyed and offers to repay the favor. He doesn't sell them the fake potions. ("Um, they aren't as potent as they could be.") Instead, he lets them choose a treasure from the Vistani treasure wagon ({@area area N9i|402|x}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們從扎洛維奇湖（{@adventure 第二章|CoS|3}，{@area 區域L|121|x}）救回了{@creature 阿拉貝拉|CoS}並安全送回營地，{@creature 魯瓦斯|CoS}會喜不自勝並打算報答恩賜。他不會賣給角色們假藥水。（"嗯......它們的效果沒有達到最佳狀態。"）相反，他讓他們從維斯塔尼藏寶四輪貨車（{@area 區域N9i|402|x}）中選擇一件寶藏。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A {@creature revenant}, as described in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, has a year to achieve its revenge before its body crumbles to dust and its soul enters the afterlife. In Barovia, however, a revenant can remain in its body indefinitely, and once it has reaped its vengeance, its soul remains trapped in Barovia.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}所述，{@creature revenant||還魂鬼}只有一年的時間完成復仇，隨後其身體就會化為塵土，靈魂則進入來世。然而，在巴洛維亞，還魂鬼可以無限期地留在自己的身體中；即使完成復仇，其靈魂仍會困在巴洛維亞。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The wooden floor creaks underfoot. Although it is safe to walk on, doing so attracts the {@creature Giant Spider||giant spiders} from {@area area Q4|433|x}. The spiders crawl up into the room and attack. The floor here is 20 feet above the floor of the ballroom.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 木製地板在腳下嘎嘎作響。雖然走在上面是安全的，但這麼做會吸引來自{@area 區域Q4|433|x}的{@creature 巨蜘蛛||巨蜘蛛}。蜘蛛們會爬進房間並攻擊。這裡的地板位於宴會廳地板上方20尺處。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The sheet of parchment is the last page of Argynvost's journal, the rest of which was destroyed. If the characters look at the torn page, show the players the "{@area Journal of Argynvost|7f9|x}" in {@adventure appendix F|CoS|23}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這張羊皮紙是奧金弗斯特日記的最後一頁，其餘部分已被摧毀。如果角色們檢視這張破損的頁面，向玩家們展示{@adventure 附錄F|CoS|23}中的"{@area 奧金弗斯特的日記|7f9|x}"。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Ezmerelda d'Avenir|CoS} (see {@adventure appendix D|CoS|21|Ezmerelda d'Avenir}) arrives at Argynvostholt on the back of a {@creature riding horse} stolen from the Vistani camp outside Vallaki ({@adventure chapter 5|CoS|6}, {@area area N9|3e8|x}). She has heard that the reportedly haunted mansion might harbor enemies of Strahd and contain secrets to the vampire's destruction.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 艾絲美拉達·德·阿維尼爾|CoS}（見{@adventure 附錄D|CoS|21|艾絲美拉達·德·阿維尼爾}）騎著一匹從瓦拉吉鎮外維斯塔尼營地（{@adventure 第五章|CoS|6}，{@area 區域N9|3e8|x}）偷來的{@creature 乘用馬}抵達了銀龍宅邸。她聽說這座據稱鬧鬼的宅邸可能藏有施特拉德的敵人，幷包含著毀滅吸血鬼的秘密。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Clovin Belview|CoS} rings the abbey's bell ({@area area S17|50b|x}) when {@creature the Abbot|CoS} decides it's time for dinner. The toll of the bell causes all the other mongrelfolk in the abbey to hoot and holler with excitement as they wait to be fed.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 克洛文·貝爾維|CoS}在{@creature 修道院長|CoS}決定開飯時敲響修道院的鈴鐺（{@area 區域S17|50b|x}）。鈴鐺聲讓修道院中所有其他混種人興奮地叫喊，等待餵食。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Otto has the Standing Leap feature (see the {@creature mongrelfolk|CoS} stat block in {@area appendix D|799|x}). His madness is embodied in the following statement: "I am the smartest, wisest, strongest, fastest, and most beautiful person I know."
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 奧圖擁有立定跳遠特性（見{@area 附錄D|799|x}中{@creature 混種人|CoS}資料卡）。他的瘋狂體現為以下陳述："我是我認識的人中最聰明、最睿智、最強壯、最快、最美麗的。"

tagShapeMismatches.english: Zygfrek has the {@sense Darkvision} feature (see the {@creature mongrelfolk|CoS} stat block in {@area appendix D|799|x}). Her madness is embodied in the following statement: "I don't like the way people judge me all the time."
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 吉格芙裡克擁有{@sense 黑暗視覺}特性（見{@area 附錄D|799|x}中的{@creature 混種人|CoS}資料卡）。她的瘋狂體現為："我總是不喜歡人們對我的評價。"

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters are escorted here by Otto and {@creature Zygfrek Belview|CoS} ({@area area S6|4cf|x}), they are asked to wait in the courtyard while the mongrelfolk fetch {@creature the Abbot|CoS} from {@area area S13|4ec|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們由奧圖和{@creature 吉格芙裡克·貝爾維|CoS}（{@area 區域S6|4cf|x}）護送到此處，他們會被要求在庭院中等待，同時混種人從{@area 區域S13|4ec|x}去請{@creature 修道院長|CoS}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: He has the Spider Climb feature (see the {@creature mongrelfolk|CoS} stat block in {@area appendix D|799|x}). In his madness, he's discovered he enjoys killing people.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 他擁有蛛行特性（見{@area 附錄D|799|x}中的{@creature 混種人|CoS}資料卡）。在他的瘋狂中，他發現他很享受殺人。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Marzena has the Flight feature (see the {@creature mongrelfolk|CoS} stat block in {@area appendix D|799|x}). Her madness is embodied in the following statement: "I am convinced that powerful enemies are hunting me, and their agents are everywhere I go. I am sure they're watching me all the time."
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 瑪澤娜具有飛行特性（見{@area 附錄D|799|x}中的{@creature 混種人|CoS}資料卡）。她的瘋狂表現為以下陳述："我堅信有強大的敵人正在追殺我，他們的代理人無處不在。我確信他們一直在監視著我。"

tagShapeMismatches.english: Clovin has the Two-Headed feature (see the {@creature mongrelfolk|CoS} stat block in {@area appendix D|799|x}). His madness is embodied in the following statement: "Being drunk keeps me sane." He is drunk most of the time, but not to the extent that it impedes his combat ability, and his musical performance improves when he is inebriated.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 克洛文具有雙頭特性（見{@area 附錄D|799|x}中{@creature 混種人|CoS}資料卡）。他的瘋狂體現在以下陳述中："只有喝醉才能讓我保持理智。"他大部分時間都處於醉酒狀態，但這並不影響他的戰鬥能力，而且當他喝醉時，他的音樂表演水平反而會提高。

tagShapeMismatches.english: This encounter occurs if the characters bring {@creature Ireena Kolyana|CoS} to Krezk, as the priest {@creature Donavich|CoS} suggested (see {@adventure chapter 3|CoS|4}, {@area area E5f|15f|x}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們按照祭司{@creature 多納維奇|CoS}的建議（見{@adventure 第三章|CoS|4}，{@area 區域E5f|15f|x}）將{@creature 伊莉娜·考利安娜|CoS}帶到克雷茨克村，就會觸發這個遭遇。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A few sections of dirt road have survived, and these places are not {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. The marsh, however, is {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. Whenever the characters take a short or long rest in the marsh, even if they barricade themselves in a ruined building, they are accosted by {@dice 1d4} swarms of hungry flies (use the {@creature Swarm of Wasps||swarm of insects (wasps)} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}). The swarms don't trouble characters in {@area areas U3|55c|x} or {@area U5|565|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 少數土路路段得以倖存，這些地方不屬於{@quickref 困難地形||3}。然而沼澤屬於{@quickref 困難地形||3}。每當角色們在沼澤中進行短休或長休時，即使他們將自己封鎖在受難者建築內，也會遭遇{@dice 1d4}群飢餓蠅群（使用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 黃蜂群||昆蟲叢集（黃蜂）}資料卡）。這些蟲群不會騷擾位於{@area 區域U3|55c|x}或{@area U5|565|x}中的角色。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Ezmerelda d'Avenir|CoS} (see {@adventure appendix D|CoS|21|Ezmerelda d'Avenir}) returns to Van Richten's Tower after confronting Strahd in Castle Ravenloft and barely escaping with her life. She arrives on the back of a {@creature riding horse} stolen from the Vistani camp outside Vallaki ({@adventure chapter 5|CoS|6}, {@area area N9|3e8|x}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 艾絲美拉達·德·阿維尼爾|CoS}（見{@adventure 附錄D|CoS|21|艾絲美拉達·德·阿維尼爾}）在鴉閣城堡中與施特拉德正面交鋒後勉強保住性命逃回到範·裡希騰的塔樓。她騎著一匹從瓦拉吉鎮外維斯塔尼營地（{@adventure 第五章|CoS|6}，{@area 區域N9|3e8|x}）偷來的{@creature 乘用馬}抵達。

tagShapeMismatches.english: From this moment on, Strahd gains a new goal: kill {@creature Ezmerelda d'Avenir|CoS}. Knowing that his Vistani spies might be conflicted at the thought of slaying one of their own, Strahd relies on the druids and the werewolves of the Svalich Woods, as well as human spies and vampire spawn hidden in Barovia's settlements, to help him find and kill Ezmerelda. If Strahd learns that she and the characters are working together, he invites the characters to Ravenloft, expecting that Ezmerelda will accompany them. The characters receive their invitation in the form of a letter delivered by one of Strahd's spies. If the characters open and read the letter, show the players the "{@area Strahd's Invitation|7f1|x}" handout in {@adventure appendix F|CoS|23}. If the characters head toward the castle, they have no threatening random encounters on the way.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 從此刻起，施特拉德獲得了一個新目標：殺死{@creature 艾絲美拉達·德·阿維尼爾|CoS}。知道自己的維斯塔尼間諜們可能會因殺害同族而內心掙扎，施特拉德依靠斯瓦里奇森林的德魯伊和狼人，以及隱藏在巴洛維亞聚居地的人類間諜和初生吸血鬼來協助他找到並殺死艾絲美拉達。如果施特拉德得知她與角色們正在合作，他會邀請角色們前往鴉閣城堡，預計艾絲美拉達會陪同他們。角色們會透過施特拉德的一名間諜遞送的信件收到邀請。如果角色開啟並閱讀信件，向玩家們展示{@adventure 附錄F|CoS|23}中的"{@area 施特拉德的邀請函|7f1|x}"資料。如果角色們前往城堡，沿途不會遭遇威脅性的隨機遭遇。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Once the arcanaloth begins casting spells, the three {@creature Flameskull||flameskulls} in {@area area X17|604|x} take up positions behind the arrow slits that overlook the temple and cast {@spell magic missile} and {@spell fireball} spells at characters they can see.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一旦奧法羅斯魔開始施展法術，在{@area 區域X17|604|x}的三個{@creature 燃焰之顱||燃焰之顱}便會各自就位到俯瞰神殿的箭垛後，對它們能看到的角色施放{@spell 魔法飛彈}和{@spell 火球術}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Hiding behind the lectern is {@creature Vilnius|CoS} (NE male human {@creature mage}) and his {@condition invisible} {@creature quasit} familiar. Characters who have a passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score of 17 or higher notice him. A character who actively searches the room for hidden occupants spots {@creature Vilnius|CoS} with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 躲在講臺後面的是{@creature 維爾紐斯|CoS}（中立邪惡男性人類{@creature 魔法師}）和他{@condition 隱形}的{@creature 小惡魔}魔寵。被動感知（{@skill 察覺}）屬性值達到17或更高的角色會注意到他。主動搜尋房間尋找隱藏居住者的角色，若成功透過{@dc 12}的感知（{@skill 察覺}）檢定即可發現{@creature 維爾紐斯|CoS}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Vilnius|CoS} carries his spellbook, which contains all the spells he has prepared. He also has a gold amulet shaped like an upside-down V hidden under his robes. Of exquisite design, the amulet is worth 1,000 gp. It is the {@item Master's Amulet|MM|control amulet} for the {@creature shield guardian} in {@area area X35|655|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 維爾紐斯|CoS} 帶著他的法術書，其中包含他準備的所有法術。他還在長袍下藏著一個倒V形的金質護符。這件護符做工精美，價值1,000 gp。它是{@area 區域X35|655|x}中{@creature 構裝盾衛}的{@item 主控護符|MM|主控護符}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The ceiling here is 20 feet high, and the walls are lined with empty torch sconces. The statue is a damaged {@creature amber golem|CoS} (use the stat block for the {@creature stone golem} in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}). It has 145 hit points and attacks any creature it sees, stopping only when it can't see any.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這裡的天花板有20尺高，牆壁上排列著空的火炬架。這尊雕像是一個損壞的{@creature 琥珀魔像|CoS}（使用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中{@creature 石魔像}的資料卡）。它有145點生命值，會攻擊任何它看到的生物，直到看不見任何生物為止。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The {@creature amber golem|CoS} in {@area area X10|5f3|x} knocked over the candlesticks and pulverized the obsidian statue, which depicted the same nameless god that stands in {@area area X5|5df|x}. Amber doors in the west wall open into {@area area X13|5f9|x}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 位於{@area 區域X10|5f3|x}的{@creature 琥珀魔像|CoS}打翻了燭臺並粉碎了黑曜石雕像，這尊雕像描繪的是與{@area 區域X5|5df|x}中相同的無名神。西牆上的琥珀門通往{@area 區域X13|5f9|x}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The lich's ancient, bronze-covered spellbook sits on a rotted divan, in plain view. Inscribed on its spine is a title: {@i The Incants of Exethanter}. The spellbook contains all the spells on the lich's list of prepared spells (see the {@creature lich} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}). The lich attacks anyone who tries to take its spellbook.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 巫妖那本遠古的、青銅封面的法術書就放在一張腐爛的長沙發上，一覽無餘。其書脊上刻著標題：{@i 艾克斯桑特之咒語}。該法術書包含了巫妖準備法術列表中的所有法術（參見{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 巫妖}資料卡）。巫妖會攻擊任何試圖拿走其法術書的人。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The ceiling here is 10 feet high. A {@creature poltergeist} (see the {@creature specter} entry in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}) haunts this room and telekinetically hurls broken furnishings at intruders so as not to give away its location.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這裡的天花板高10尺。一個{@creature 騷靈}（見{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 惡靈}條目）盤踞在這個房間，並用念力向入侵者投擲破碎的傢俱，以免暴露自己的位置。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Not all of the thieves escaped, and the pulverized remains of those who died here lie strewn upon the floor. Their restless spirits survive here as four {@creature Poltergeist||poltergeists} (see the {@creature specter} entry in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}). The poltergeists can't leave the room and fight until destroyed.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 並不是所有竊賊都成功逃脫，那些死在這裡的人被碾碎的遺骸散落在地板上。他們不安的精魂在這裡以四個{@creature 騷靈||騷靈}的形式存在（參見{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 惡靈}條目）。這些作祟幽靈無法離開房間，並且會戰鬥至被摧毀。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The amber doors to the south are sealed with an {@spell arcane lock} spell. The password to suppress the spell is "Dhaviton." A character can push open the doors with a successful {@dc 25} Strength check. The doors (AC 15, 60 hit points) can also be smashed. If the doors are reduced to 0 hit points, a {@spell greater invisibility} spell is cast on the {@creature amber golem|CoS} in this room. The spell lasts for 1 minute.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 南部的琥珀門由一道{@spell 秘法鎖}法術密封。壓制該法術的密碼是"Dhaviton"。角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 25}力量檢定來推開這些門。這些門（AC 15，60點生命值）也可以被砸碎。如果門的生命值被降至0點，房間內的{@creature 琥珀魔像|CoS}將對自己施放一道{@spell 高等隱形術}法術。該法術持續1分鐘。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The ceiling here is 30 feet high and flat. The statue in the northern alcove is an {@creature amber golem|CoS} (use the stat block for the {@creature stone golem} in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}). It attacks any creature that disturbs the treasure. The golem can leave the room but can't leave the Amber Temple.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這裡的天花板高30尺且平整。北側壁龕中的雕像是尊{@creature 琥珀魔像|CoS}（使用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中{@creature 石魔像}的資料卡）。它會攻擊任何打擾寶藏的生物。魔像可以離開這個房間但不能離開琥珀神殿。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The Gulthias tree has AC 15, 250 hit points, and immunity to bludgeoning, piercing, and psychic damage. If it is reduced to 0 hit points, it seems to be destroyed but isn't truly dead; it regains 1 hit point every month until it is fully healed. With a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Nature}) check, a character can determine that the entire stump must be uprooted for the tree to truly die. The Gulthias tree withers and dies in {@dice 3d10} days if a {@spell hallow} spell is cast in its area.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 甘提亞斯樹有 15 AC、250 點生命值，並且免疫鈍擊、穿刺和心靈傷害。如果它被降至 0 點生命值，它看上去似乎被摧毀了，但並沒有真正死亡；它每個月恢復 1 點生命值，直到完全痊癒。透過一次成功於 {@dc 15} 的智力（{@skill 自然}）檢定，一名角色可以得知整個樹墩必須被連根拔起，才能讓樹真正地死去。如果在其區域內施放了 {@spell 聖居} 法術，甘提亞斯樹就會枯萎並在 {@dice 3d10} 天內死亡。

tagShapeMismatches.english: You can allow this event to unfold regardless of whether the characters have visited Yester Hill. Even if the characters don't experience this event as it happens, they can still deal with the aftermath (see "{@area Wintersplinter Attacks|5cb|x}" in the "Special Events" section in {@adventure chapter 12|CoS|13}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 你可以展開這個事件，不管角色們有沒有去過往日山丘。 即使角色們沒有經歷這個事件，他們仍然可以處理後續的餘波。 （參見{@adventure 第十二章|CoS|13}"特殊事件"小節中的{@area 冬刺來襲|5cb|x}）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: This event doesn't occur if the characters previously encountered and defeated Kiril's hunting pack (see "{@area Pack Attack|58c|x}" in the "Special Events" section in {@adventure chapter 11|CoS|12}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們之前遇到並擊敗了基裡爾的狩獵部隊（見{@adventure 第十一章|CoS|12}"特殊事件"小節中的"{@area 部落來襲|58c|x}"），這個事件就不會發生。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If either the dollhouse or the chest is disturbed, the ghosts of {@creature Rosavalda "Rose" Durst|CoS|Rose} and {@creature Thornboldt "Thorn" Durst|CoS|Thorn} appear in the middle of the room. Use the {@creature ghost} statistics in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, with the following modifications:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果娃娃屋或箱子被驚動，{@creature 羅莎瓦爾妲"玫瑰"·杜爾斯特|CoS|玫瑰}和{@creature 索恩博爾特"荊棘"·杜爾斯特|CoS|荊棘}的幽魂就會出現在房間中央。使用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 幽魂}資料，但需進行以下修改：

tagShapeMismatches.english: The {@item Tome of Strahd|CoS} is an ancient work penned by Strahd, a tragic tale of how he came to his fallen state. The book is bound in a thick leather cover with steel hinges and fastenings. The pages are of parchment and very brittle. Most of the book is written in the curious shorthand that only Strahd employs. Stains and age have made most of the work illegible, but several paragraphs remain intact and readable. If the characters acquire the {@item Tome of Strahd|CoS} and want to read these paragraphs, show the players the "{@area From the Tome of Strahd|7f3|x}" section in {@adventure appendix F|CoS|23}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@item 施特拉德手記|CoS} 是一本由施特拉德親筆寫下的古老作品，講述了他如何墮落到如此境地的悲劇故事。這本書由厚皮革封面裝訂，帶有鋼鐵鉸鏈和扣件。書頁是羊皮紙製成且非常脆弱。書中大部分內容是用只有施特拉德使用的古怪速記法寫成。汙漬和歲月侵蝕使大部分內容難以辨認，但有幾段文字仍儲存完整可讀。如果角色們獲得了{@item 施特拉德手記|CoS} 並想要閱讀這些段落，請向玩家們展示{@adventure 附錄F|CoS|23}中的"{@area 《施特拉德手記》殘頁|7f3|x}"小節。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Use the {@creature deva} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, but change {@creature The Abbot|CoS|the Abbot's} alignment to lawful evil.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 使用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature 天神使徒}資料卡，但將{@creature 修道院長|CoS|院長的}陣營改為守序邪惡。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Use the {@creature mage} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}, with the following adjustments:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 使用《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》中的{@creature 魔法師}資料卡，並進行以下調整：

tagShapeMismatches.english: A character cursed with wereraven lycanthropy gains a Dexterity of 15 if his or her score isn't already higher. Attack and damage rolls for the wereraven's bite are based on whichever is higher of the character's Strength and Dexterity. The bite of a wereraven in raven form deals 1 piercing damage (no ability modifier applies to this damage) and carries the curse of lycanthropy; see the "{@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|MM}" sidebar in the lycanthropes entry in the {@book Monster Manual|MM} for details.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一個被鴉人化症詛咒的角色，如果其敏捷屬性值未達到15，則提升至15。鴉人啃咬的攻擊與傷害擲骰基於角色的力量或敏捷屬性值中較高者。處於渡鴉形態的鴉人的啃咬造成1點穿刺傷害（此傷害不應用屬性調整值）並攜帶獸化詛咒；詳情請參閱{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中獸化人條目下的"{@variantrule 玩家角色|MM}"側邊欄。

numericDifferences.english: Now we were face to face with random encounter number thirty-four: a vampire. Not a Vampire with a capital V, but a so-many-Hit-Dice-with-such-and-such-an-Armor-Class lowercase vampire. Just another monster in the dungeon.
numericDifferences.localized: 現在我們面對的是隨機遭遇 34 號：吸血鬼。不是那種吸血鬼傳說中那樣厲害角色，而是淹沒在茫茫怪海里的一隻普通怪物，一隻生命骰和護甲等級比較高的地下城怪物。

numericDifferences.english: Module I6: {@i Ravenloft}, written by Tracy and Laura Hickman, broke new ground by presenting a D&D adventure that was as much story-driven as location-based, featuring a villain who was complex and terrifying. Castle Ravenloft, with its amazing three-dimensional maps, remains to this day one of the most iconic and memorable of all D&D dungeons.
numericDifferences.localized: I6 模組：{@i 鴉閣魔域}，由崔西·西克曼和勞拉·西克曼創作，藉由鮮明的地域特色、強勁的故事驅動力，開創性地塑造了一位複雜而駭人的反派角色。鴉閣城堡那讓人驚歎的3D地圖，至今仍是D&D歷史上最具有代表性、最讓人念念不忘的地城之一。

numericDifferences.english: {@adventure Chapter 1|CoS|2} also outlines Strahd's goals, and it suggests adventure hooks to draw the player characters into the cursed realm of Barovia. If the characters are 1st level, the character background in {@adventure appendix A|CoS|18} is available to them, and consider starting their time in Barovia with the mini-adventure "Death House" in {@adventure appendix B|CoS|19}.
numericDifferences.localized: {@adventure 第一章|CoS|2}也交待了施特拉德的目的，和一些可用的冒險契機，用來把玩家的角色釣到巴洛維亞這片被詛咒的土地上。如果玩家只有一級，那麼他們可以使用{@adventure 附錄A|CoS|18}中的角色背景。DM 可以用{@adventure 附錄 B|CoS|19} 裡的小模組"死亡之屋"來開始玩家在巴洛維亞的冒險。

numericDifferences.english: When you're ready to begin the card reading, remove the fourteen cards with the crown icon (the high deck) and shuffle them. Then shuffle the remaining cards (the common deck), keeping the two decks separate. Draw the top three cards from the common deck and lay them face down in the 1, 2, and 3 positions. Then draw the top two cards from the high deck and lay them face down in the 4 and 5 positions, as shown below:
numericDifferences.localized: 進行占卜時，先把14張帶王冠標記的牌（至高牌）拿出來，洗牌。再洗剩下的牌（普通牌），兩疊牌要分開。拿起普通牌那疊最上面的三張，牌面朝下放在1、2、3號位置。再從至高牌那疊最上方拿起兩張牌，牌面朝下放在4號和5號位置。完成的牌陣如下。

numericDifferences.english: {@b Seven of Swords—{@card Hooded One|Tarokka Deck|CoS}}
numericDifferences.localized: {@b 寶劍7—{@card Hooded One|Tarokka Deck|CoS|蒙面之人}}
{@b 錢幣 1—{@card Swashbuckler|Tarokka Deck|CoS|風流劍客}}

numericDifferences.english: {@b Five of Coins—{@card Guild Member|Tarokka Deck|CoS}}
numericDifferences.localized: {@b 錢幣5—{@card Guild Member|Tarokka Deck|CoS|公會成員}}

numericDifferences.english: {@b Eight of Coins—{@card Tax Collector|Tarokka Deck|CoS}}
numericDifferences.localized: {@b 錢幣8—{@card Tax Collector|Tarokka Deck|CoS|稅收徵收者}}
{@b 雕紋6—{@card Anarchist|Tarokka Deck|CoS|無政府主義者}}

numericDifferences.english: This card refers to Sir Klutz the {@creature phantom warrior|CoS} (see {@adventure chapter 4|CoS|5}, area K84, {@area crypt 33|301|x}). If Sir Klutz is Strahd's enemy, then the phantom warrior disappears not after seven days, but only after he or Strahd is reduced to 0 hit points.
numericDifferences.localized: 這張牌指向{@creature phantom warrior|CoS|魅影武者}特里帕洛斯基爵士（見{@adventure 第四章|CoS|5}，區域K84，{@area 墓穴33|301|x}）。如果特里帕洛斯基爵士是卡牌占卜出的施特拉德的敵人，那麼他不會在7天之後消失，而是在他或施特拉德其中一方生命值減少到0後消失。

numericDifferences.english: Eravien believes that he can gain prestige within the Lords' Alliance if he learns the whereabouts of the "ancient portal" that the werewolves are using and destroys it. He is convinced that the portal represents a danger not only to Daggerford but also to Waterdeep. Any Lords' Alliance character who agrees to destroy it is given a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell magic weapon}. Eravien also promises to furnish the character with a letter of recommendation (see "{@book Marks of Prestige|DMG|7|Marks of Prestige}" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}) once the portal is destroyed.
numericDifferences.localized: 伊拉維恩認為，如果他能找到狼人正在使用的"遠古傳送門"的下落並摧毀它，就能在領主聯盟中獲得聲望。他確信這個傳送門不僅對匕首灘構成威脅，也對深水城構成危險。任何同意摧毀傳送門的領主聯盟角色都會獲得一張{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}的{@spell magic weapon||魔化武器}法術卷軸。伊拉維恩還承諾，一旦傳送門被摧毀，他將為角色提供一封推薦信（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第七章中的"{@book 名望的標誌|DMG|7|Marks of Prestige}"）。

numericDifferences.english: Davra Jassur (LE female human {@creature Vistana Assassin|CoS|assassin}) poses as a recruiter for the Black Network but is, in fact, a cutthroat who quietly disposes of competitors. Her husband, Yarak, was also a member of the Black Network. He was escorting a caravan traveling from Daggerford to the Way Inn (about sixty miles southeast of Daggerford, along the Trade Way) when the werewolves attacked. Yarak was slain, and Davra wants revenge; she wants the head of the werewolf pack leader. She is too tied up with "business" to engage in a personal vendetta, but if another member of the Black Network were to help, she would owe that individual a special favor (see "{@book Marks of Prestige|DMG|7|Marks of Prestige}" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
numericDifferences.localized: 達芙拉·賈瑟（守序邪惡 女性 人類 {@creature Vistana Assassin|CoS|刺客}）偽裝成黑網的招募者，但實際上是一個會悄悄除掉競爭對手的割喉者。她的丈夫亞拉克也曾是黑網的成員。他在護送一支從匕首灘前往路間旅館（位於匕首灘東南約六十英里處，沿著貿易公路）的商隊時，遭到了狼人的襲擊。亞拉克被殺，達芙拉想要復仇；她想要那個狼人叢集頭領的腦袋。她因"商業"事務纏身，無法親自進行這場私人仇殺，但如果黑網的另一位成員願意協助，她將欠下此人一份特殊的恩賜（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第七章的"{@book 名望的標誌|DMG|7|Marks of Prestige}"）。

numericDifferences.english: The area within the fog is {@quickref Vision and Light||2||heavily obscured} (see "{@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||Vision and Light}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}).
numericDifferences.localized: 迷霧內的區域處於{@quickref Vision and Light||2||重度遮蔽}狀態（參見{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}第八章中的"{@quickref Vision and Light|PHB|2||視野與光照}"）。

numericDifferences.english: When a humanoid who has been dead for at least 24 hours returns to life, either by way of a spell or some supernatural means, it gains a random form of indefinite madness brought on by the realization that its spirit is trapped in Barovia, likely forever. To determine how this madness is expressed, roll on the {@table Indefinite Madness} table in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
numericDifferences.localized: 當一個類人生物死亡至少24小時後，透過法術或某種超自然手段復活時，它會獲得一種隨機的永久性瘋狂形態，這是因為它意識到自己的精魄被困在巴洛維亞，很可能永遠無法離開。要確定這種瘋狂的表現形式，請在{@book 城主指南|DMG}第八章的{@table Indefinite Madness||永久性瘋狂}表格上進行擲骰。

numericDifferences.english: Evil druids left this trail. Following it in either direction leads to a spiked pit (see "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). A thin tarp made of twigs and pine needles conceals the pit, the bottom of which is lined with sharpened wooden stakes.
numericDifferences.localized: 邪惡的德魯伊留下了這條小徑。沿著小徑往任一方向走都會遇到一個尖刺陷坑（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章的"{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}"）。一層由細枝和松針做成的薄防水層掩蓋著陷坑，坑底排列著鋒利的木樁。

numericDifferences.english: Barovian hunters and trappers set these traps hoping to thin out the wolf population, but Strahd's wolves are too clever to be caught in them. If none of the characters in the front rank spots the hidden trap, one random party member steps on it. Rules for the {@item hunting trap|PHB} are presented in chapter 5, "{@book Equipment|PHB|5}," of the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}.
numericDifferences.localized: 巴洛維亞的獵人和捕獸者設定了這些陷阱，希望能減少狼的數量，但施特拉德的狼太聰明瞭，不會被它們困住。如果前排的角色都沒有發現隱藏的陷阱，就會有一個隨機隊員踩到它。{@item hunting trap|PHB|捕獵陷阱}的規則在《{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}》第五章"{@book 裝備|PHB|5}"中給出。

numericDifferences.english: The floor of the tower is made of packed earth. Its interior is {@hazard desecrated ground} (see "{@book Wilderness Hazards|DMG|5|Wilderness Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). Against the inside wall of the tower, across from the open doorway, is a closed, empty wooden chest.
numericDifferences.localized: 塔樓的地板由夯實的土製成。其內部是{@hazard desecrated ground||褻瀆之地}（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章中的"{@book 野外危害物|DMG|5|Wilderness Hazards}"）。在塔樓內側牆壁上，正對著敞開的門口，有一個關閉的空木箱。

numericDifferences.english: Characters can pass through ordinary webs, including thick cobwebs, without fear of being {@condition restrained} or slowed down. A character can clear away the cobwebs from a 10-foot square as an action. Webs woven by giant spiders are a different matter; see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for rules on giant spider webs.
numericDifferences.localized: 角色可以穿過普通的蛛網，包括稠密的蛛網，而不用擔心被{@condition restrained||束縛}或減速。一名角色可以用一個動作清理掉10尺見方的蛛網。但是巨蜘蛛織的網就不一樣了；關於巨蜘蛛網的規則，請參閱{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"。

numericDifferences.english: A patch of {@hazard green slime} (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}) clings to the portcullis in the entry tunnel, and can be spotted with a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The slime will not fall on characters entering the castle, but it does fall on the first character who leaves by this route.
numericDifferences.localized: 一團{@hazard green slime||綠軟泥}（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"）黏在入口隧道的鐵閘上，透過成功的{@dc 20}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定可以發現它。軟泥不會掉在進入城堡的角色頭上，但會掉在第一個經由此路線離開的角色頭上。

numericDifferences.english: If Mordenkainen isn't the party's ally as foretold in {@creature Madam Eva|CoS}'s card reading (see {@area chapter 1|021|x}), he declines to join them if asked. With his wits restored, he sets out to find his missing staff and spellbook, leaving the characters on their own. He doesn't allow them to help him, for he fears they might be tempted to steal either his staff or his spellbook. (Being an adventurer himself, he knows how the lure of powerful magic can bring out the worst in adventurers.) Before he leaves, as a parting gift, the {@creature The Mad Mage of Mount Baratok|CoS|archmage} imbues each character with a {@reward charm of heroism} (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
numericDifferences.localized: 如果魔鄧肯不是如{@creature Madam Eva|CoS|伊娃夫人}的卡牌占卜（見{@area 第一章|021|x}）所預言的那樣成為隊伍的盟友，那麼在被邀請時他會拒絕加入他們。隨著他的神智恢復，他動身去尋找他遺失的法杖和法術書，將角色們獨自留下。他不允許他們協助他，因為他擔心他們可能會受到誘惑去偷竊他的法杖或法術書。（作為一名冒險者，他深知強大魔法的誘惑如何能激發出冒險者最壞的一面。）在他離開之前，作為臨別贈禮，{@creature The Mad Mage of Mount Baratok|CoS|大法師}為每個角色灌注了一個{@reward charm of heroism||英勇護咒}（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第七章中的"{@book 超自然贈禮|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}"）。

numericDifferences.english: In addition to the lore known to all Barovians (see "{@area Barovian Lore|0ad|x}" in chapter 2), {@creature Donavich|CoS} knows the following useful information:
numericDifferences.localized: 除了所有巴洛維亞人已知的傳聞（見第二章"{@area 巴洛維亞傳聞|0ad|x}"），{@creature Donavich|CoS|多納維奇}還知道以下有用資訊：

numericDifferences.english: Thirty feet below the masonry wall and 50 feet above the foot of the steps, a small crack has formed in the outer wall of the stairwell. The crack is 1/2 inch wide, 5 inches tall, and 12 inches deep; it leads to the castle's wine cellar ({@area area K63|254|x}). Characters can notice the crack automatically as they climb or descend the stairs. Widening the crack enough to squeeze through the wall requires major excavation and would take several days.
numericDifferences.localized: 在石牆下方30尺、臺階底部上方50尺處，樓梯井的外牆上形成了一道小裂縫。裂縫寬1/2吋，高5吋，深12吋；它通向城堡的紅酒地窖（{@area 區域K63|254|x}）。角色在上下樓梯時可以自動注意到這道裂縫。要將裂縫擴大到足以擠過牆壁的程度需要大量挖掘工作，並且需要好幾天時間。

numericDifferences.english: Massive stairs rise to a landing twenty feet wide by forty feet long. Stone arches support a ceiling covered with frescoes twenty feet overhead. The frescoes depict armored knights on horseback, their finer features faded beyond recognition.
numericDifferences.localized: 巨大的樓梯向上通往一個20尺寬、40尺長的平臺。20尺高的上方，石質拱架支撐著覆滿壁畫的天花板。壁畫描繪著全副武裝的騎士們騎在馬背上，他們的精細面容已經褪色到無法辨認。

numericDifferences.english: This vantage point is 130 feet from the bottom of the shaft ({@area area K31a|1f4|x}). Forty feet down is {@area area K31|1f2|x}, and 40 feet up is a stone trapdoor in the ceiling that opens into {@area area K47|225|x}.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個觀察點距離豎井底部130尺（{@area 區域K31a|1f4|x}）。向下40尺是{@area 區域K31|1f2|x}，向上40尺的天花板上有一個岩石活板門，通向{@area 區域K47|225|x}。

numericDifferences.english: Most of the hall is full of giant spider {@hazard webs} (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). Characters who stray from the unobstructed path through the webs risk becoming stuck.
numericDifferences.localized: 大廳的大部分割槽域都充滿了巨蜘蛛的{@hazard webs||蛛網}（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章"冒險環境"中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"）。偏離無障礙路徑穿越蛛網的角色可能會被纏住。

numericDifferences.english: Most of the belfry is filled with giant spider {@hazard webs} (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). Characters who blunder into them risk becoming stuck.
numericDifferences.localized: 鐘樓的大部分割槽域都佈滿了巨蜘蛛的{@hazard webs||蛛網}（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章"冒險環境"中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"）。角色們若不小心闖入其中，有被粘住的風險。

numericDifferences.english: The plundered riches of Strahd's secret hoard lie within this adamantine tower, which is actually a {@item Daern's instant fortress} (see chapter 7, "Treasure," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). Only Strahd knows the command word to alter its shape and size, which can't be done until every bit of treasure inside it is removed. Only Strahd can open the two means of entry: a sealed adamantine door set into the base of the tower on the north side, and an adamantine trapdoor on the roof.
numericDifferences.localized: 施特拉德掠奪而來的秘密寶藏都躺在這座精金塔樓中，它實際上是一座{@item Daern's instant fortress||迪恩的摺疊要塞}（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第七章"寶藏"）。只有施特拉德知道改變它形狀和體型的命令語，而在將它內部的所有寶藏都搬空之前也無法對它的形狀和大小加以改變。只有施特拉德可以開啟進入的兩條通路：一道密封的精金門扉位於塔樓基座北邊的牆上，以及一道精金活板門位於塔樓頂上。

numericDifferences.english: The creature that erupts from the tub is no more real than the blood. It can't be harmed and doesn't attack. It scuttles across the ceiling, disappearing into area K44 through one of the archways. Once there, it disappears.
numericDifferences.localized: 從浴缸中衝出來的生物並不比鮮血更真實。它不能被傷害也不會攻擊。它會快速從天花板透過，穿過一扇拱門消失在區域K44。一旦到達區域K44，它就會完全消失。

numericDifferences.english: All creatures trapped inside the elevator (including {@condition unconscious} ones) must roll initiative. The compartment takes 1 round to reach the top of the shaft, stopping just beneath {@area area K47|225|x}. Each creature inside has one turn to act before the compartment comes to a dead stop. Their initiative rolls determine the order in which the occupants act. Conscious party members can take whatever actions they like. They might search for a way out, wake sleeping party members, cast spells, or take other actions. {@condition Unconscious} ones can do nothing.
numericDifferences.localized: 所有被困在升降梯內的生物（包括{@condition unconscious||昏迷}者）必須擲先攻。轎廂需要一輪時間到達豎井頂部，停在{@area 區域K47|225|x}正下方。每個轎廂內的生物在轎廂完全停止前有一回合的行動時間。他們的先攻骰決定居住者行動的秩序。清醒的隊員可以採取任意動作。他們可以搜尋出路、喚醒沉睡的隊員、施展法術或執行其他動作。{@condition Unconscious||昏迷}者則什麼都做不了。

numericDifferences.english: Five of these casks are rotted and empty. The wine name burned on each is Red Dragon Crush. Lining the interior of the sixth one is a patch of {@hazard yellow mold} (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). A character who inspects the cask closely and succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check sees yellow mold in the cracks between the planks of the cask. If this cask is smashed open, the yellow mold releases a cloud of spores.
numericDifferences.localized: 其中五個酒桶已腐壞且空了。每個酒桶上燒印的酒名是紅龍碾壓。第六個酒桶內壁有一塊{@hazard yellow mold||黃黴菌}（見{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}，位於{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章"冒險環境"中）。近距離檢查該酒桶且成功透過一次{@dc 13}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定的角色將在酒桶木板接縫處發現黃黴菌的存在。如果這個酒桶被砸開，黃黴菌將釋放出一片孢子云。

numericDifferences.english: Once a mess hall for the castle guards, this room is now {@hazard desecrated ground} (see "{@book Wilderness Hazards|DMG|5|Wilderness Hazards}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
numericDifferences.localized: 這裡曾是城堡警衛們的餐廳，現在已成為一片{@hazard desecrated ground||褻瀆之地}（詳見《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》第五章"冒險環境"中的"{@book 野外危害物|DMG|5|Wilderness Hazards}"）。

numericDifferences.english: The stoppered drinking horn is a water-resistant {@item Gunpowder Horn||powder horn} loaded with gunpowder, and the "weird-looking scepter" is a {@item musket}. The fat pouch contains 20 silver marbles ({@item silvered sling bullet|PHB|silvered bullets} for the musket). For more information on firearms and explosives, see chapter 9, "{@book Dungeon Master's Workshop|DMG|9}," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個塞住的象牙角杯是一個防水的{@item Gunpowder Horn||角瓶}，裡面裝滿了火藥，而那根"看起來怪怪的節杖"是一把{@item musket||滑膛槍}。那個鼓鼓囊囊的小包裡裝著20顆銀彈丸（用於滑膛槍的{@item silvered sling bullet|PHB|鍍銀子彈}）。關於槍械與爆炸物的更多資訊，請參閱{@book 城主指南|DMG}的第九章"{@book 地下城主工坊|DMG|9}"。

numericDifferences.english: A patch of {@hazard brown mold} (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}) fills the crypt. Characters within 5 feet of the crypt's open doorway are affected.
numericDifferences.localized: 一片{@hazard brown mold||棕黴菌}（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章"冒險環境"中的"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"）佈滿了墓穴。位於墓穴敞開的門口5尺內的角色會受到影響。

numericDifferences.english: West of town is a haunted mansion (see chapter 7, "{@adventure Argynvostholt|CoS|8}"). Legend has it that a dragon died there long, long ago.
numericDifferences.localized: 鎮子以西有一處鬧鬼的宅邸（見第七章"{@adventure 銀龍宅邸|CoS|8}"）。傳說很久很久以前，有一條龍死在了那裡。

numericDifferences.english: If your card reading reveals that a treasure is here, the item is hidden in a trunk. Each character has a cumulative {@chance 20} chance of finding the item for every hour the character spends searching the attic.
numericDifferences.localized: 若你的卡牌占卜顯示寶藏在這裡，該物品藏在一個象鼻中。每個角色在閣樓中每搜尋1小時，就有累計{@chance 20}的機率找到該物品。

numericDifferences.english: The closet contains shelves of fancy footwear and many fine garments, including a black ceremonial robe with a hood (similar to the ones worn by the cult fanatics in {@area area N4t|3c7|x}). On a high shelf rests a locked iron chest. Lady Wachter hides the key to the chest on a tiny hook in the fireplace, under the mantel. A character who takes a minute to search the fireplace finds the key with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. Use of the key disables a poison needle trap hidden in the lock (see "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). A creature that triggers the trap and fails the saving throw against the needle's poison falls {@condition unconscious} for 1 hour instead of being {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour.
numericDifferences.localized: 壁櫥裡放著各種精美的鞋履和許多優質服裝，包括一件帶兜帽的黑色儀祭長袍（與{@area 區域N4t|3c7|x}的邪教狂信者所穿類似）。高處架子上放著一個上鎖的鐵箱。瓦赫特女士將箱子的鑰匙藏在壁爐的一個微型鉤爪上，位於壁爐架下方。角色花費1分鐘搜尋壁爐並透過{@dc 10}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定即可找到鑰匙。使用鑰匙會解除隱藏在鎖中的毒針陷阱（參見{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章"冒險環境"中的"{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}"）。觸發陷阱且未能透過針對針上毒素的豁免檢定的生物將陷入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態1小時，而非{@condition poisoned||中毒}1小時。

numericDifferences.english: The key to the chest can be found in the library ({@area area N4p|3be|x}). Use of the key disables a poison needle trap hidden in the lock (see "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
numericDifferences.localized: 開啟箱子的鑰匙可以在圖書館（{@area 區域N4p|3be|x}）中找到。使用鑰匙可以解除鎖中隱藏的毒針陷阱（見"{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}"，選自{@book 城主指南|DMG}第五章"冒險環境"）。

numericDifferences.english: The stockyard is a general store and a facility where storage sheds can be rented. It is owned by a middle-aged married couple, Gunther and Yelena Arasek (LG male and female {@creature Commoner||commoners}). They sell items from the {@book Adventuring Gear|PHB|5|Adventuring Gear} table in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB} that have a price of 25 gp or less, but at five times the price.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個貨棧是一家雜貨店，也有棚屋倉庫可供租用。它由一對中年夫婦岡瑟和葉蓮娜·阿拉瑟克（守序善良的男性和女性{@creature Commoner||平民}）經營。他們出售{@book 冒險用品|PHB|5|Adventuring Gear}表（見{@book 玩家手冊|PHB}）中價格在25gp或以下的物品，但以5倍的價格出售。

numericDifferences.english: The Vistani keep all their treasure in this wagon. The door to the wagon has two locks, each of which requires a different key. {@creature Luvash|CoS} carries one key, {@creature Arrigal|CoS} the other. Each lock is rigged with a poison needle trap (see "{@book Sample Traps|DMG|5|Sample Traps}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
numericDifferences.localized: 維斯塔尼人將所有寶藏都存放在這輛馬車中。馬車的門上有兩把鎖，每把鎖都需要不同的鑰匙。{@creature Luvash|CoS|魯瓦斯} 持有一把鑰匙，{@creature Arrigal|CoS|阿利格爾} 持有另一把。每把鎖都裝有毒針陷阱（參見《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》第五章"冒險環境"中的"{@book 陷阱範例|DMG|5|Sample Traps}"）。

numericDifferences.english: The room contains an iron tub and has wood paneling on the walls that rises to a height of three feet. Above the paneling, the walls are painted with a continuous, faded mural of a mountainscape.
numericDifferences.localized: 這房間有一個鐵浴盆，並且在牆上有著3尺高的木版。在木版之上，牆壁上有著連綿不斷、褪色的山景壁畫。

numericDifferences.english: This room has dark wood paneling on the walls that rises to a height of three feet. Above the paneling, the walls are painted with murals of religious figures performing holy rites. In the center of the west wall is a tattered curtain hanging in an open doorway. Three tall, slender stained-glass windows set into the opposite wall depict figures in white robes with orange sunrises behind their heads.
numericDifferences.localized: 這房間沿牆鋪有著3尺高的深色木鑲板。在鑲板上方，牆壁上繪製著正在舉行神聖儀式的宗教人物壁畫。西牆中央有一道敞開的門，門上懸掛著破舊的幕布。對面的牆上鑲嵌著三面高大細長的彩色玻璃窗，描繪著身著白色長袍的人物，他們頭後方有橙色的日出朝陽。

numericDifferences.english: Beyond a ragged edge of stone is a sixty-foot plunge to the rubble-strewn ground below. A few rafters stick out from beneath the stone.
numericDifferences.localized: 越過破爛的岩石邊緣，是縱降60尺至下方散佈著瓦礫的地面。幾根椽木從岩石下方刺出。

numericDifferences.english: In addition to the information known to all Barovians (see {@area "Barovian Lore"|0ad|x} in chapter 2), the villagers of Krezk (called Krezkites) know the following bits of local lore:
numericDifferences.localized: 除所有巴洛維亞人已知的情報外（見第二章的{@area "巴洛維亞傳聞"|0ad|x}），克雷茨克村的村民（稱為克雷茨克人）還知道以下當地傳聞：

numericDifferences.english: Even in the gloom, you can make out a monstrous shape lumbering down the hall. When the darkness can no longer hide its true nature, your eyes are treated to a terrifying, 7-foot-tall assemblage of human body parts.
numericDifferences.localized: 即使在陰暗中，你也能辨認出一個怪異的形體在大廳裡蹣跚而行。當黑暗再也無法掩蓋其真實本質時，你的眼睛將看到一個由人體部位組成的、七尺高的恐怖集合體。

numericDifferences.english: Ilya Krezkov returns to life with a random form of indefinite madness (see "{@book Madness Effects|DMG|8|Madness}" in chapter 8, "Running the Game," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). {@creature The Abbot|CoS} uses the raising of Ilya as leverage to get the burgomaster to undertake an unusual quest (see "Something Borrowed" below).
numericDifferences.localized: 伊利亞·克雷茨科夫復活時獲得一種隨機的永久性瘋狂（見"{@book 瘋狂的效應|DMG|8|Madness}"，選自{@book 城主指南|DMG}第八章"運作遊戲"）。{@creature The Abbot|CoS|修道院長}以復活伊利亞為籌碼，讓鎮長完成一項不尋常的任務（見下方"一樣借"）。

numericDifferences.english: Tsolenka Pass is a gravel road that hugs Mount Ghakis, climbing to great heights. The road starts at the Raven River crossroads ({@adventure chapter 2|CoS|3}, {@area area R|130|x}) and travels seven miles to a gatehouse ({@area areas T1|532|x}–{@area T3|535|x}) and a guard tower ({@area areas T4|536|x}–{@area T6|53b|x}), as well as a stone bridge ({@area areas T7|53f|x}–{@area T9|543|x}) that spans the Luna River. Wind and snow make the journey treacherous. Without some way to keep warm, characters who aren't dressed for cold weather suffer the effects of extreme cold at night (see "{@book Weather|DMG|5|Weather}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
numericDifferences.localized: 索倫卡山道是一條緊挨加奇斯山的礫石道路，蜿蜒攀升至高處。這條路始於渡鴉河十字路口（{@adventure 第二章|CoS|3}，{@area 區域R|130|x}），經過七英里抵達一座門樓（{@area 區域T1|532|x}–{@area T3|535|x}）和一座守衛塔樓（{@area 區域T4|536|x}–{@area T6|53b|x}），以及一座橫跨月光河的石橋（{@area 區域T7|53f|x}–{@area T9|543|x}）。風雪使得旅途充滿危險。若無保暖措施，未穿著禦寒衣物的角色在夜晚會遭受嚴寒效應（參見《{@book 城主指南|DMG}》第五章"冒險環境"中的"{@book 天氣|DMG|5|Weather}"）。

numericDifferences.english: Beyond this arch, Tsolenka Pass hugs the mountainside for three miles before branching north and south. The northern branch leads to the Amber Temple ({@adventure chapter 13|CoS|14}). The southern branch continues to wrap around Mount Ghakis until it ends at the deadly fog that surrounds Barovia (see chapter 2, "{@area Mists of Ravenloft|0a3|x}").
numericDifferences.localized: 在此拱門之外，索倫卡山道緊貼著山壁延伸三英里，隨後分岔為北向和南向。北向岔路通往琥珀神殿（{@adventure 第十三章|CoS|14}）。南向岔路繼續環繞加奇斯山，直至盡頭被環繞巴洛維亞的致命迷霧所阻斷（見第二章，"{@area 鴉閣魔域的迷霧|0a3|x}"）。

numericDifferences.english: There is no gate in the fence, and {@creature Baba Lysaga|CoS} uses her flying skull (see {@area area U3|55c|x}) to enter and leave the pen. If the characters try to set the goats free by dismantling or damaging part of the fence, the skulls atop the fence posts begin howling and continue to howl for 1 minute. The racket attracts {@creature Baba Lysaga|CoS}, who arrives in her flying skull on initiative count 20 in 2 rounds. The howling skulls also attract the seven {@creature Scarecrow||scarecrows} in the marsh (see "{@area Marsh Scarecrows|550|x}" above). Roll initiative once for all the scarecrows.
numericDifferences.localized: 籬笆沒有門，{@creature Baba Lysaga|CoS|芭芭·萊薩迦}使用她的飛行頭骨（見{@area 區域U3|55c|x}）進出羊圈。如果角色們為了釋放山羊而嘗試撤除或是破壞籬笆的一部分，籬笆柱頭的顱骨就會開始嚎叫並持續1分鐘。這陣喧鬧會吸引{@creature Baba Lysaga|CoS|芭芭·萊薩迦}，她會在先攻數20時駕駛她的飛行頭骨在兩回合內抵達此處。嚎叫的顱骨也會吸引沼澤中的七具{@creature Scarecrow||稻草人}（見上文的"{@area 沼澤稻草人|550|x}"）。為所有稻草人擲一次先攻。

numericDifferences.english: Strahd had this monument erected after Marina's death. The monument is hidden in the marsh, and the characters aren't likely to find it on their own unless they scour the area thoroughly. If they lay Burgomaster Ulrich's spirit to rest (see {@area area U2|554|x}), it points them to this location before fading away. Without Ulrich's guidance, the characters must enter the square in which the monument is located and search that area. A character who searches the area for 10 minutes can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, finding the monument on a success. If the monument isn't found, the check can be repeated after another 10 minutes of searching.
numericDifferences.localized: 施特拉德在瑪莉娜死後建起了這座紀念碑。這紀念碑隱藏在沼澤內，而角色們不太可能靠自己找到它，除非他們徹底調查這片區域。如果他們讓烏爾裡希鎮長的靈魂安息（見{@area 區域U2|554|x}），鎮長會在消散之前，點出這個地方。沒有烏爾裡希的指引，角色們必須進入紀念碑安放的方格，並搜尋該區域。一名角色搜尋該區域10分鐘，可以做一次{@dc 15}的感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定，成功的話，可以找到紀念碑。如果沒有找到紀念碑，再花十分鐘搜尋可以重做一次檢定。

numericDifferences.english: The third time this trap is triggered, the magic fails and causes the tower to collapse. Each creature inside the tower when it collapses takes 132 ({@dice 24d10}) bludgeoning damage, while those within 20 feet of the tower must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 44 ({@dice 8d10}) bludgeoning damage from falling debris. The collapse not only destroys the tower but also most of its contents, including the animated armor in {@area area V7|588|x}. The wooden chest in area V7 (as well as the severed head inside it) remains intact but requires {@dice 1d8 + 2} hours of digging through rubble to find. The clay golems in {@area area V4|582|x} are undamaged but buried under piles of debris. Every hour the characters spend searching through the rubble, they have a {@chance 10} chance of accidentally unearthing a berserk clay golem.
numericDifferences.localized: 當這個陷阱第三次被觸發後，魔法失效並導致塔樓坍塌。塔樓坍塌時，塔內的每個生物承受132（{@dice 24d10}）鈍擊傷害，而塔外20尺內的生物必須成功透過{@dc 15}的敏捷豁免檢定，否則因墜落碎片受到44（{@dice 8d10}）鈍擊傷害。坍塌不僅摧毀了塔樓，還毀掉了大部分塔內物件，包括{@area 區域V7|588|x}的活化盔甲。區域V7的木箱（以及裡面的斷頭）保持完好，但需要挖掘瓦礫{@dice 1d8 + 2}小時才能找到。{@area 區域V4|582|x}的粘土魔像未受損傷但被埋在瓦礫堆下。角色們每在瓦礫中搜尋1小時，就有{@chance 10}的機率意外挖出一個狂怒的粘土魔像。

numericDifferences.english: A captured werewolf can be forced to divulge the whereabouts of the children kidnapped by the pack. They are being held in a cave to the west (see chapter 15, "{@adventure Werewolf Den|CoS|16}").
numericDifferences.localized: 一個被俘虜的狼人可以被逼問出狼群所綁架的孩子們的下落。他們被關押在西邊的一個洞穴裡（見第十五章"{@adventure 狼人窩|CoS|16}"）。

numericDifferences.english: Characters who have a light source can see brown mold covering the walls, floor, and ceiling around the archway and the cave beyond. Growing throughout this area, keeping the wine cellar cool, are ten patches of {@hazard brown mold} (see "{@book Dungeon Hazards|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}" in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). The characters are safe from the mold as long as they keep their distance.
numericDifferences.localized: 攜帶光源的角色們可以看到，拱廊周圍的牆上、地上、天花板上甚至其後的洞穴裡都覆蓋著{@hazard brown mold||棕黴菌}。 10 片棕黴菌在這一區域生長，保持著酒窖的涼爽（見"{@book 地城危害物|DMG|5|Dungeon Hazards}"，選自{@book 城主指南|DMG}第5章"冒險環境"）。只要角色們保持距離，就不會受到黴菌的傷害。

numericDifferences.english: If the characters leave the winery and return at a later time before dealing with Wintersplinter (see the "{@area Druids' Ritual|685|x}" section in chapter 14), the enormous {@creature tree blight|CoS} (see {@area appendix D|76b|x}) is sent from Yester Hill to ravage the vineyard and destroy the winery.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色們離開酒莊並在處理冬刺之前稍後返回（見第十四章"{@area 德魯伊們的儀式|685|x}"小節），巨大的{@creature tree blight|CoS|枯樹怪}（見{@area 附錄D|76b|x}）將從往日山丘被派來蹂躪葡萄園並摧毀酒莊。

numericDifferences.english: The Amber Temple is a cold, dark place carved out of the snowy slope of Mount Ghakis. The temperature throughout the complex is −10 degrees Fahrenheit (−23 degrees Celsius). Characters who don't have heat sources, cold weather gear, or magic to protect them are subject to the effects of extreme cold, as described in the "{@book Weather|DMG|5|Weather}" section in chapter 5, "Adventure Environments," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. If {@creature Kasimir Velikov|CoS} (see {@adventure chapter 5|CoS|6}, {@area area N9a|3ed|x}) is with the party, his {@item ring of warmth} protects him from the effects of the extreme cold.
numericDifferences.localized: 琥珀神殿是一處在加奇斯山白雪覆蓋的山坡上開鑿出來的寒冷黑暗之地。建築物中的溫度為華氏 -10 度（攝氏零下 23 度）。沒有熱源也沒帶著防寒用具或魔法防禦的角色將會受到極度嚴寒的影響（見"{@book 天氣|DMG|5|Weather}",選自{@book 城主指南|DMG}第5章"冒險環境"）。如果{@creature Kasimir Velikov|CoS|卡西米爾·維里科夫}（見{@adventure 第五章|CoS|6}的{@area 區域N9a|3ed|x}）在隊伍中，他的{@item ring of warmth||溫暖戒指}可以使他自己免受極度嚴寒的影響。

numericDifferences.english: A dark gift functions like a charm (see "{@book Supernatural Gifts|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}" in chapter 7, "Treasure," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}). A creature doesn't receive a dark gift if it is being manipulated or coerced, or if it declines the gift. Once it receives a dark gift, a creature can never receive that same dark gift again.
numericDifferences.localized: 黑暗贈禮的運作方式與護咒一樣（見"{@book 超自然贈禮|DMG|7|Supernatural Gifts}"，選自{@book 城主指南|DMG}第七章"寶藏"中的）。生物在被操控、被脅迫或其自身拒絕接受贈禮時，無法獲得任何黑暗贈禮。一旦接受了某個黑暗贈禮，該生物就再也不能接受相同的黑暗贈禮。

numericDifferences.english: The furnishings of this bare stone room have succumbed to decrepitude. Standing in the center of the room, its head scraping the ten-foot-high ceiling, is a vaguely man-shaped construct made of dark wood and riveted iron. Its helmed head stares blindly in your direction. Cobwebs stretch from this terrible artifice to the wrecked furniture that surrounds it.
numericDifferences.localized: 這個光禿石室的陳設在時間的流逝下已經分崩離析。房間中央站著一尊由黑木和鐵鉚釘製成的模糊人形構裝體，其頭部已經刮擦到了10尺高的天花板。它戴著頭盔的頭部無神地凝視著你的方向。蜘蛛網從這可怕的構裝體一直延伸到其周圍已經損毀的傢俱上。

numericDifferences.english: Any creature that enters the deadly fog is subject to its effects (see the "{@area Mists of Ravenloft|0a3|x}" section in chapter 2).
numericDifferences.localized: 任何進入致命迷霧的生物都會受到其效應影響（見第二章的"{@area 鴉閣魔域的迷霧|0a3|x}"部分）。

numericDifferences.english: Here, the cave splits to the left and right. Standing on a five-foot-high ledge between the divide are two feral-looking women wearing shredded clothing and clutching spears.
numericDifferences.localized: 這裡，洞穴向左右分岔。在分岔路間的5尺高巖架上，站著兩位外貌兇猛、衣著破爛並手持長矛的女性。

numericDifferences.english: Rough-hewn stairs lead down to a torchlit cave and a bizarre sight: wide-eyed children stand behind wooden bars and stare at you in terrified silence. The cave holds six wooden cages, their lids held shut with heavy rocks. Two of the cages are empty, and each of the others holds a pair of frightened children.
numericDifferences.localized: 粗鑿的樓梯通往一個以火炬照亮的洞穴，展現一副奇異的景象：孩子們在木柵欄後面睜大著眼睛，在恐懼的沉默中緊盯著你們。這個洞穴裡有6個木製的籠子，它們的蓋子被沉重的石頭壓住。兩個籠子是空的，其餘的每個籠子裡都有一對受驚的孩子。

numericDifferences.english: Before the characters can explore the haunted townhouse known as Death House, you need to guide them to the village of Barovia. The "{@area Creeping Fog|09e|x}" adventure hook in chapter 1 works best, as it introduces few distractions. Once the characters arrive in Strahd's domain, steer them to the village. For the duration of this introductory adventure, any attempt by the characters to explore other locations in Strahd's domain causes the mists of Ravenloft to block their path.
numericDifferences.localized: 在角色們能夠探索被稱為死亡之屋的鬧鬼聯排別墅之前，你需要引導它們前往巴洛維亞村。第一章中的"{@area 蔓延之霧|09e|x}"冒險引子效果最佳，因為它引入的幹擾較少。一旦角色們抵達施特拉德的領地，就將它們引向村莊。在這段介紹性冒險的持續時間內，任何角色試圖探索施特拉德領地中其他地點的嘗試都會導致鴉閣魔域的迷霧阻擋它們的路徑。

numericDifferences.english: Characters who remain outside the house can see the mists close in around them, swallowing up the rest of the village. As more buildings disappear into the mists, the characters are left with little choice but to seek refuge in the house. The mists stop short of entering the house but engulf anyone outside (see chapter 2, "{@area The Lands of Barovia|0a3|x}," for information on the mists' effect).
numericDifferences.localized: 留在屋外的角色可以看到迷霧向他們逼近，吞沒了村莊的其餘部分。隨著更多建築物消失在迷霧中，角色們別無選擇，只能在這座房屋中尋求庇護。迷霧在房屋入口處止步，但會吞沒任何留在外面的人（關於迷霧的效果，請參閱第二章"{@area 巴洛維亞各地區|0a3|x}"）。

numericDifferences.english: The chest contains three blank books with black leather covers (worth 25 gp each), three {@item Spell Scroll||spell scrolls} ({@spell bless}, {@spell protection from poison}, and {@spell spiritual weapon}), the deed to the house, the deed to a windmill, and a signed will. The windmill referred to in the second deed is situated in the mountains east of Vallaki (see chapter 6, "{@adventure Old Bonegrinder|CoS|7}"). The will is signed by Gustav and Elisabeth Durst and bequeathes the house, the windmill, and all other family property to Rosavalda and Thornboldt Durst in the event of their parents' deaths. The books, scrolls, deeds, and will age markedly if taken from the house but remain intact.
numericDifferences.localized: 箱子裡有三本黑色皮革封面的空白書籍（每本價值25 gp）、三張{@item Spell Scroll||法術卷軸}（{@spell bless||祝福術}、{@spell protection from poison||防護毒素}和{@spell spiritual weapon||靈體武器}）、房屋的地契、一座風車的地契和一份帶簽名的遺囑。第二份地契中提到的風車位於瓦拉奇鎮東邊的山脈中（見第六章"{@adventure 碾骨老磨坊|CoS|7}"）。遺囑由古斯塔夫和伊麗莎白·杜爾斯特簽署，在父母死亡的情況下，將房屋、風車和所有其他家族財產遺贈給羅莎瓦爾妲和索恩博爾特·杜爾斯特。這些書籍、卷軸、地契和遺囑如果被帶離房屋會明顯老化，但保持完好。

numericDifferences.english: If Strahd sees, or learns from a minion, that the tome has fallen into the party's possession, all of his other objectives (see chapter 1, "{@adventure Into the Mists|CoS|2}") are put on hold until the book is recovered. When Strahd attacks, his preferred target is whoever has the tome.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果施特拉德看到、或從其部下那裡得知這本書已經落入到了冒險小隊的附身之中，他所有其他的目標（見第一章"{@adventure 進入迷霧|CoS|2}"）都將被延後，直到這本書被重新奪回。當施特拉德攻擊時，他的首選目標是持有這本書的人。

numericDifferences.english: The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 hit points. An animated object reduced to 0 hit points becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.
numericDifferences.localized: 當一個活化物件 HP（生命值）降至 0 點時，活化它的魔法將會失效。同時在其因為生命值歸零而失去活化時，該物品會受到嚴重損壞以至於失去所有價值並無法被再度使用。

numericDifferences.english: Some {@creature Broom of Animated Attack|CoS|brooms of animated attack} allow their creators to ride them, in which case they behave like typical {@item Broom of Flying||brooms of flying}. A broom of animated attack, however, can carry only half the weight that a {@item broom of flying} can (see chapter 7, "{@book Treasure|DMG|7}," of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}).
numericDifferences.localized: 一些{@creature Broom of Animated Attack|CoS|活化戰鬥掃帚}允許它們的創造者騎行它們，在這種情況下它們表現得就像典型的{@item Broom of Flying||飛行掃帚}。然而，活化戰鬥掃帚只能承載{@item broom of flying||飛天掃帚}一半的重量（見{@book 城主指南|DMG}的第七章"{@book 寶藏|DMG|7}"）。

numericDifferences.english: The half-elf ringmaster is, in fact, a legendary human vampire hunter named Rudolph van Richten. Van Richten's tale is a sad one. A scholar and doctor from a land called Darkon, he married his childhood sweetheart, Ingrid, and together they had a son, Erasmus. When he was fourteen, Erasmus was stolen away by Vistani and sold to a vampire named Baron Metus to be used as a companion. By the time van Richten found his son, it was too late: the baron had already transformed Erasmus into a vampire spawn. Erasmus begged his father to end his suffering, which van Richten did by pounding a wooden stake through his son's chest. Baron Metus avenged that deed by killing van Richten's wife, and van Richten has lived with the horror of his family's destruction ever since. After destroying Baron Metus in turn, van Richten sought revenge against the Vistani and took up a life of hunting evil monsters.
numericDifferences.localized: 這名半精靈馬戲班班主其實是一位名叫魯道夫·範·裡希騰的傳奇人類吸血鬼獵人。他的過往充滿悲傷。他是一名來自達孔地方的學者和醫生，與他的青梅竹馬的戀人英格麗德 Ingrid 結為夫婦併產下一子，名叫伊拉斯謨 Erasmus。伊拉斯謨在 14 歲時被維斯塔尼人偷走了，並被賣給了一位名叫米特斯男爵 Baron Metus 的吸血鬼，以和他做伴。當範·裡希騰最終找到他的兒子的時候，一切已經太晚了，男爵已經把伊拉斯謨轉化成了初生吸血鬼。伊拉斯謨乞求自己的父親終結他所受的折磨，最終範·裡希騰只能將一隻木樁釘穿他兒子的胸膛來滿足兒子的心願。作為報復，米特斯男爵將範·裡希騰的妻子殘忍殺害，自此範·裡希騰始終被家破人亡的恐懼所折磨著。在最終，範·裡希騰以牙還牙、以眼還眼地消滅了米特斯男爵，隨後開始了對維斯塔尼人的復仇，並投入一生來狩獵邪惡的怪物。

numericDifferences.english: A character cursed with wereraven lycanthropy gains a Dexterity of 15 if his or her score isn't already higher. Attack and damage rolls for the wereraven's bite are based on whichever is higher of the character's Strength and Dexterity. The bite of a wereraven in raven form deals 1 piercing damage (no ability modifier applies to this damage) and carries the curse of lycanthropy; see the "{@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|MM}" sidebar in the lycanthropes entry in the {@book Monster Manual|MM} for details.
numericDifferences.localized: 一個被鴉人化症詛咒的角色，如果其敏捷屬性值未達到15，則提升至15。鴉人啃咬的攻擊與傷害擲骰基於角色的力量或敏捷屬性值中較高者。處於渡鴉形態的鴉人的啃咬造成1點穿刺傷害（此傷害不應用屬性調整值）並攜帶獸化詛咒；詳情請參閱{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中獸化人條目下的"{@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|MM|玩家角色}"側邊欄。

numericDifferences.english: Each suit contains cards numbered one through nine, plus a tenth card that is called the master of that suit. A card can be referred to by its suit designation or by its name. For instance, the three of glyphs is also known as the {@card healer|Tarokka Deck|CoS}, and the {@card wizard|Tarokka Deck|CoS} card is also known as the master of stars.
numericDifferences.localized: 每種花色都有編號1至9的牌，以及第10張稱為該花色「主牌」的牌。每張牌都可以用花色與編號，或用牌名來稱呼。例如，雕紋3也稱為{@card healer|Tarokka Deck|CoS|醫療師}，而{@card wizard|Tarokka Deck|CoS|法師}牌也稱為星星主牌。

numericDifferences.english: The remaining fourteen cards make up the high deck, which symbolizes the natural forces of the multiverse. These cards are represented by a crown symbol and are the most powerful cards in the deck.
numericDifferences.localized: 其餘14張牌是至高牌，象徵著多元宇宙的自然力量。這些牌都有王冠標記，是整套牌組中最強力的牌。
